overloads.semanticRole: SEND RECORD sends the current record of aTable to the serial port or document opened by the SET CHANNEL command.

constraints: If aTable is omitted, the default table is used.
If no current record exists in the table, the command has no effect.
Requires a serial port or document previously opened via SET CHANNEL; cannot be used with a document opened via Open document, Create document, or Append document.

The record is sent in a special internal format readable only by RECEIVE RECORD; source and destination table structures must be compatible or 4D converts values per the destination table definitions.
Beginning with 4D v11, this command no longer supports subtables.
